tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /brgya bzhi'i cho ga 'chi bdag kun bzlog ces bya ba bzhugs/

na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rtsa ba'i bla ma dang/ /mi 'jigs bzhi ldan thub dbang la btud nas/ /brgya bzhi'i cho ga mkhyer bde kun phan zhig /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal phyir bri/ /'di la gsum/ sngon 'gro ba/ dngos gzhi/ mjug gi ram pa'o/ /dang po la bca' gzhi sogs ni/ sa stegs sam ras shog sogs gzhi gtsang ma gang yang rung ba'i steng du rdul tshon nam/ tshon gzhan gyis dbus su pad 'dab brgyad lte ba dang bcas pa'i phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma dmar/ me rlung gnyis ser/ bden bral ljang*/ dbang ldan nagalte ba ljang*/ ge sar ser po bya zhing*/ 'di la shar dkar ba sogs spyi ltar yang byar rung ngo*/ lte bar sangs rgyas kyi phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya phyag mthil dang phyag sor kyi nang dmar po/ de la mu 'khyud ser po byas pa'i steng du mañdzi chen po'am/ ma rnyed na shing gi rkang gsum btsugs pa'i dbus thog tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i gser sku'am sman sku bzhugs par bya zhing*/ dbu thog tu dar ram ras shog sogs kyi gdugs sam mda' dar 'dzug phyag gi mthe'u chung la lha bdud dkar po/ srin lag la nyon mongs pa'i bdud dmar po/ gung mo la 'chi bdag gi bdun nag go mdzub mo la phung po'i bdud ser po'i gzugs brnyan zan 'jims sogs la bcos pa'am/ bris pa'ang rung ste kha phyag mthil phyogs la bstan nas 'god/ phyag mthil du ngar phye las sbyin bdag gam/ nad pa'i glud mig sogs kyi skye mched dod pa bya ste/ de yang zer mo'i skra/ lung thang gi mig mu tig gi klad pa/ dar dmar gyi lce/ mgron bu'i so/ lag pa g.yas gser dang g.yon dngul/ rkang pa g.yas zangs dang g.yon lcags las byas pa/ ma grub na mtshon byed ci rigs byas la rgyan gos dang bcas ste bzhag pad 'dab kyi mthar gru bzhir bcad pa'i phyogs bzhi po re rer sa'i tstsha nyer lnga re 'god/ de bzhin du de'i phyi rim la mar me brgya/

de'i phyi rim la zan gyi ngar mi brgya/ de'i phyi rim pa lha bshos brgya/ de'i phyi rol tu phyogs bzhir chu gnyis nyer spyod tshang ba tshar re/ mdun du bdud bzhir 'bul gtor zur gsum sha khrag gis brgyan pa mtheb kyu brgya rtsa gcig gis bskor ba/ glud rdzongs pa ni rin po che dar sna gos sna sman sna zas sna 'bru sna shing tog chang phud gser skyems rnams dang*/ gzhan yang bla ma mchog gsum dang yi dam chos skyong gzhi bdag so so'i gtor ma rnams dang*/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rnams tshar gcig gnyis sogs ci 'grub/ sātstsha rab gnas can yin na ma gtogs rab gnas bya dgos pas cho ga'i dkyus su bris na 'jug pa mi bde bas mjug tu 'chad do/ /gnyis pa cho ga dngos bzhi la 'jug tshul la gnyis/ bdag bskyed dang*/ mdun bskyed ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rang thub dbang phyag rdor 'jigs byed rta mgrin sogs yi dam gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed rdzogs par bya zhing*/ bsdu na skad cig gis krong bskyed kyang rung ste/ brgya bzhi'i cho ga kha cig las rang yi dam du gsal ba'i zhes pa tsam las mi 'byung ba'i phyir dang*/ rigs pa gzhan gyis kyang 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa mdun bskyed la gnyis/ 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ 'jig rten ba'i mgron ji ltar bskyed pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la/ paṇa chen gyi cho gar rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis 'das pa'i mgron rnams spyan drangs nas yan lag bdun pa dang mchod pa ci rigs 'bul ba las gzhan mi gsal bas tshul de bzhin du byas kyang rung bar shes mod/ 'di'i cho ga mdzad pa bo kha cig 'das pa'i mgron rnams bris pa'i maṇḍal gyi dbus su bskyed par mdzad snang bas de bzhin du bshad par bya'o/ /'di la gnyis/ gnas dang mchod pa byin brlab bya ba dang*/ bskyed tshul dngos so/ /dang po ni 'di ltar byas na bde ste/

bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lha tshogs dang*/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /rten 'brel bslu med chos dbyings bden stobs dang*/ /gsang sngags rigs sngags lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus/ /gnas 'di rnam par dag pa'i zhing mchog tu/ /yongs gyur mchod sprin rgya mtsho chad med cing*/ /bsam gyis mi khyab sa dang bar snang khyon/ /ma lus gang bar 'byung zhing rgyas gyur cig /oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum gyis gnas byin gyis brlab po/ /gnyis pa ni/ maṇḍal a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba gur bla re me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su seṅge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du/ sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i gdan la bcol ldan 'das dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa sku mdog ser po gser btso ma lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams pa/ sku la chos gos ngur smrig gsol zhing*/ mtshan so gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis 'od kyi phung bo'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su byams pa dang shā ri'i bu/ g.yon tu 'jam dpal dang mo'u 'gal gyi bu/ mdun du spyan ras gzigs dang kun dga' bo/ rgyab tu phyag rdor dang 'od srung chen po/ de'i phyi rol tu rab 'byor la sogs pa dgra bcom pa'i tshogs rnams dang*/ mdun phyogs su tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyis gdugs la sogs pa mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa thogs nas mchod par byed pa/ steng phyogs su rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor nas bzhugs shing*/

de'i mtha' bskor du gtsang rigs kyi dpal mgon don lnga la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i mgron gzhan rnams kyis gnam sa bar snang gi khyon thams can gang nas bzhugs par gyur/ spos phor sogs dang bcas te/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ /bdud sde'i dpung tshogs mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus yang dag mkhyen gyur ba'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /ces pa tsam mam/ sbro na/ bcom ldan bskal ba grangs med du ma ru/ /zhes pa nas/ /yongs dag 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /thub pa'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin kun skyong bar/ /thub pa'i spyan sngar zhal bzhes dam bcas pa'i/ /thub pa'i bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i chogs/ /thub pa'i bstan pa srung phyir gnas 'dir gshegs/ /mgon po kun gshegs gdan la bzhugs/ /zhes sogs rkang ba drug gi mthar/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig dang*/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /zhes sogs gcig gi mthar/ padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ de nas sngon du phyag 'tshal ba ni/ thabs mkhas thugs rje sogs dang*/ ji snyed su dag ces pa nas rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/ /zhes pa'i bar dang*/ phyag byar 'os pa zhes sogs gyis phyag dang*/ de nas mchod pa rnams/ hriḥṣtā+-ir lta bu'am/ a mṛtas bsangs/ sā bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shir rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ nas/ rol mo la sogs pa rnams dang shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyam bar gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ nas/ spar sha āḥhūṃ gis byin gyis brlabs te/ phyogs bcu'i rab 'byams zhing dag na/ /ji snyed mchis pa'i mchod yon dang/ /bdag gis dngos bshams yid sprul 'di/ /thub dbang mchog gsum 'khor bcas mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta'am/

oṃ shākya mu ne sarba gu ru buddhā bo dhi sa twa sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ pra tī tstsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin zhabs bsil sogs dang*/ pā dyaṃ sogs sbyar nas/ shapta'i bar dar/ phyogs bcu'i rab 'byams zhig dag na/ / gzugs mchog ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /bdag gis 'bul ba'i gzugs mchog 'di/ /thub dbang mchog gsum 'khor bcas mchod/ /rū pa sogs dang*/ sgra mchogadri mchogaro mchogareg mchog dang*/ shapta nas/ sparsha'i bar sbyar nas 'bul/ yang na/ rin chen dbang gi rgyal po zhes sogs kyis 'bul lo/ /zhing 'di 'khor lo rin chen gyis/ /mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang ste/ /dngos grub 'dod pa sbyin pa'i phyir/ /nyin re shes rab can gyis 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra ratna pra tī tstsha= de bzhin du/ nor bu/ btsun mo/ blon po/ glang po/ rta mchog dmag dpon rin chen zhes sogs dang*/ ma ṇi ratna nas/ khaṅga ratna'i bar sbyar nas rgyal srid bdun dang*/ yang na/ zhing 'di rgyal srid sna bdun gyis/ /zhes sogs dang*/ ma hā sa pā ra tās 'bul/ gzhan yang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan sogs/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad gling bzhi ri/ /nyi zla kun bzang mchod sprin tshogs/ /thub dbang mchog gsum 'khor bcas mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta aṣta maṅga laṃ maṇḍal pra tītstsha hūṃ swāhā/ thabs mkhas thugs rjes shākya'i rigs 'khrungs shing*/ /zhes sogs dang*/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /zhes sogs dang*/ /phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhes sogs dang*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis na/ /zhes sogs yan lag bdun pa bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ mgron rnams kyi ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/

oṃ shākya mu ne sarba gu ru budhā bho dhi sa twa sa pā ri wa ra i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum mam bdun gyis 'bul/ sngags de'i mthar/ arghaṃ nas shapta pra tītstsha hūṃ swāhā sbyar nas mchod de/ snyigs ma'i mgon po mnyam med shākya'i tog /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas la/ /gus pas bstod do mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /zhes pa'am/ phyag byar 'os pa zhes sogs kyis bstod/ gal te bskang gso byed skabs 'dir mngon rtogs nas 'bul gtor gyi bar bya/ de min sngar gyi mjug nas mar me spar te chab bran nas spos kyis bdug gnyis pa la lnga/ 'jig rten pa'i 'gron sbyan 'dren pa/ mchod rdzas 'bul ba/ 'phrin las bcol pa/ bstod pa/ glud rdzong gi skor ro/ /dang po ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros bdud bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa dang gnod byed kyi mgron rnams thams cad sbyan drangs/ skad cig gis rang gi mdun du byon par gyur/ rol mo'i byangs dang bcas/ 7 kyai/ sngon tshe sum cu rtsa gsum na/ /lha dbang brgya byin 'khor tshogs kyis/ /yongs bskor 'dod pa'i longs spyod la/ /dga' mgur spyod cing gnas pa'i dus/ /'chi bdag bdud sogs bdud rnam bzhis/ /zin nas sdug bsngal thob pa'i tshe/ /sdug bsngal sel thabs ston pa la/ /zhus shing skyabs su song ba na/ /bcom ldan rgyal ba shāka thub ches/ /lha dbang brgya byin don ched dang*/ /ma 'ongs 'gro la phan pa'i phyir/ /mchod sbyin brgya bzhi'i rdzas bsags te/ /bdud bzhi bkug nas sbyin btang bas/ /lha dbang snyun las grol bar mdzad/ /de bzhin da lta yon bdag gis/ /bdud dang 'byung po gdon bgegs sogs/ /mi min gnod pa zhi ba dang*/ /ltas ngan mi shis bzlog don du/ /mchod sbyin brgya bzhi'i rdzas bsags nas/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs te/ /stobs chen bdud bzhi 'khor bcas rnams/

/mchod sbyin ched du spyan 'dren na/ /thogs med 'phrul gyis gshegs su gsol/ kyai/ nam mkha' mtha' yas gnas mchog nas/ /myang 'das thob la bgegs byed pa'i/ /phung po'i bdud tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /gnas 'dir sbyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /rnam shes mtha' yas= /gnas lugs rtogs la= /nyon mongs bdud= /gnas 'dir= /ci yang med pa'i=/ 'dod chags bral la=/ lha'i bu'i bdud=/ gnas 'dir =/ yod min med min=/ che mthar phyin la=/ 'chi bdag bdud=/ gnas 'dir=/ kyai/ lha bdud dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin/ /'dir gshegs thub pa'i phyag sor gyi/ /mthe'u chung rtse mor rang gdan la/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs su gsol/ /phung po'i bdud ser nor bu 'dzin/ /'dir gshegs= /mdzub mo'i rtse mor= /dgyes pa'i= /nyon mongs bdud dmar padma 'dzin/ /'dir gshegs= /srin lag rtse mor= /dgyes pa'i= /'chi bdag bdud nag ral gri 'dzin/ /'dir gshegs= /gung mo'i rtse mor= /dgyes pa'i= /thub pa'i phyag sor bzhi yi rtser/ /rang rang gzugs dang dbyer med gyur/ /gnyis pa mchod rdzas 'bul ba la gnyis/ mchod pa gzhan dang*/ brgya bzhi'i mchod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa rnams te/ de yang*/ kyai/ rgya mtsho lta bur 'khyil ba'i mchod yon dang*/ /gaṅgā'i rgyun ltar 'bab pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ /bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bdud dang bgegs kyi gnod pa zhi bar mdzod/ kha dog rnam bkra mdzes pa'i me tog dang*/ /dud sprin nam mkhar khyab pa'i bdug spos 'di/ /bdud bzhi'i= /bdud dang = /rab 'bar mtshar du dngar ba'i mar me dang*/ /lus kyi gdung ba kun sel dri chab 'di/ /bdud bzhi'i= /bdud dang = /ro brgya'i bcud nus ldan pa'i zhal zas dang*/ /sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra dbyangs snyan pa 'di/ /bdud bzhi'i= /bdud = /mig la dga' ston ster ba'i gzugs mchog dang*/ /rna ba'i bcud len 'gyed pa'i sgra dbyangs 'di/

/bdud bzhi'i= /bdud dang = /bsung ngad phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i dri mchog dang*/ /kha dog ro nus ldan pa'i zhal zas 'di/ /bdud bzhi'i= /bdud dang = /reg na bde ba ster ba'i gos mchog dang*/ /'dod rgu 'byung ba'i dpag bsam shing chen 'di/ /bdud bzhi'i= / bdud dang = /'khor lo nor bu btsun mo blon po dang*/ /glang po rta mchog dmag dpon rin chen bdun/ /bdud bzhi'i = /bdud dang = /rgyal mtshan gdugs dung gser nya dpal gyi be'u/ /bum pa padma bkra shis rtags brgyad rnams/ / bdud bzhi'i= /bdud dang = /gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla bcas pa dang*/ /gzhan yang ji snyed mchod pa'i tshogs kun kyang*/ /bdud bzhi'i= /bdud dang = / bgegs kyi gnod pa zhi bar mjod/ /ces brjod cing*/ bsdu na rkang ba phyi ma gnyis po kun tha ma tsam la sbyar chog go /gnyis pa la gnyis/ brgya bzhi'i mchod rdzas byin brlab bya ba dang*/ 'bul tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i brgya bzhi'i mchod rdzas rnams mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing*/ mgron rnams dgyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i byed las khyad par can dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gsum/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shuddhe dharmāḥte badzra siddhi hūṃ/ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba tatkhaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmāḥnāṃ arya nutpanna twa ta/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūṃ/ oṃ ru ru sphu ru dzwa la tiṣṭha siddha lo tsa ni sarba artha sā dha ni swāhā/ bdag gi bsam pa'i nas/ 'byung gyur cigaces sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs la/ gnyis pa 'bul tshul la dang po lha bshos brgya po de/ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūṃ/

zhes pa lan nye gcig gis byin gyis brlabs shing*/ lha'i bu'i bdud la bsngos te/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang*/ /gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu dang*/ /ye 'brog bdun brgya nad kyi rigs/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zhi bar mdzod/ /ces spyir bskul nas/ badzra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bye brag tu 'bul bcol ni/ 7 kyai/ lha bdud dkar po bya ba khyod/ /shes bya'i sgrib pa dag las byung*/ /bdud bzhi'i gnod pa sel ba'i thabs/ /bdag cag rgyu sbyor yon bdag gis/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i 'bru zan gyis/ /zhal zas bshos bu brgya rtsa sogs/ /brgya bzhi'i mchod pa 'd-is mtshon pa'i/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa yi/ /mthun rdzas re ba skor byed 'di/ /sngags rgyas mang por rab spel te/ /lha bdud dkar po 'khor bcas la/ /'bul lo mchod do bzhes su gsol/ /thub dbang rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang*/ /bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs kyis/ /de ring rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /mchod sbyin brgya bzhi'i glud 'di longs/ /glud 'di longs la nad 'di phrol/ /nad 'di phrol ba gdon 'di zlog /gdon 'di bzlog la tshe 'di bsrings/ /nad phrol gdon bzlog tshe bsrings shig /༈ kyai/ rab yangs nam mkha' lta bu'i snod rnams su/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i btung ba mtsho ltar bskyil/ /bza' dang bca' ba ri rab lta bur spungs/ /bkod mdzes sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma brgya/ /lha bu'i bdud tshogs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /sor rtog ye shes rnam dag chos kyi sku/ /bcom ldan 'od dpag med pa'i sku thob nas/ /'gro kun lha bu'i bdud las thar gyur cig /ces brjod/ /gnyis pa mar me brgya po de sngar ltar sngags kyis nyon mongs pa'i bdud la bsngos te/ blang don gnas la ma rmongs pa'i/ /ma rig mun stugs sel ba dang*/ /chags sogs nyon mongs shugs drag po'i/ /gdug rtsub ma lus zhi bar mdzod/ /zhes dang*/

arghaṃ sogs gyis mchod de/ 7 kyai/ nyon mongs bdud ni dmar po khyod/ /dug lnga'i sgrib pa dag las byung*/ /bdud bzhi'i gnod pa= /bdag cag = /'bru mar dang ni rtsi mar gyi/ /snang gsal sgron me brgya rtsa sogs/ /brgya bzhi'i mtshod tshogs 'dis = /dngos bsham= /mthun rdzas= /sngags rgyas= /nyon mongs bdud chen 'khor= /'bul lo= thub dbang = /'den pa= /de ring = /mchod sbyin= /glud 'di= /nad 'di= /gdon 'di= /nad phrol=/ 7 kyai/ stong gsum mtshar du dngar ba'i snod rnams su/ /'bru mar rtsi mar rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /ri rab lta bu'i mar me'i sngon bu la/ /nyi zla lta bu'i 'ong 'bar snang gsal brgya/ /nyon mongs bdud tshogs= /mnyam nyid ye shes= /bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan= /'gro kun nyon mongs bdud las thar gyur cig /ces brjod/ gsum pa ngar glud brgya bo de sngar bzhin 'chi bdag gi bdud la bsngos te/ nad pa dag dang glud brjes nas/ /'chi bdag bdud kyi rgyal po la/ /bsngos pas sbyin bdag dus min gyi/ /'chi bdag dag las thar par mdzod/ /de nas*/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod de/ kyai/ 'chi bdag bdud ni nag po khyod/ /las kyi sgrib pa dag las byung*/ bdud bzhi'i= /bdag cag= /'bras zan rin chen sna lnga yi/ /srog glud ngar mi brgya rtsa sogs/ /brgya bzhi'i= /dngos bshams= / mthun rdzas= /sngags rgyas= /'chi bdag bdud= /'bul lo= /thub dbang = / bden pa= /de ring = /mchod sbyin= /glud 'di= nad 'di=/ gdon 'di= /nad phrol= /kyai 'bru zan rin chen rnam pa lnga las byung*/ /gzugs mdzes dbyangs snyan yid dang dbang po sogs/ /mdzes pa gcig tu bsdus pa'i nor mang ldan/ /yon tan brgya phrag ldan pa'i ngar glud brgya/ /'chi bdag bdud tshogs= /bya grub ye shes= bcom ldan don yod grub pa'i= /'gro kun 'chi bdag bdud las thar gyur cig /ces brjod/ bzhi pa sātstsha brgya po de sngags kyis sngar bzhin phung po'i bdud la bsngos te/

/dam pa'i gzugs brnyan sātstsha brgya/ /phung po'i bdud chen la bsngos pas/ /glo bur rnams shes phung po lnga/ /'bral ba'i bar chad zhi bar mdzod/ /ces dang*/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod de/ kyai/ phung po'i bdud ni ser po khyod/ /bag chags sgrib pa dag las byung*/ /bdud bzhi'i= /bdag cag= /rin chen rdul mang las grub pa'i/ / mchod rten sātstsha brgya phrag sogs/ /brgya bzhi'i= /dngos bshams= /mthun rdzas= /sngags rgyas= phung po'i bdud chen= /'bul lo= /thub dbang = /bden pa= /de ring = /mchod sbyin= /glud 'di= nad 'di= /gdon 'di= /nad phrol=/ kyai/ rin chen sna lnga'i rdul tshon las grub pa'i/ /ri rab mtshar du dngar ba'i mchod rten brgya/ /phung bo'i bdud tshogs 'khor dang =/ me long ye shes rnam dag chos kyi sku/ /bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad sku thob nas/ /'gro kun phung po'i bdud las thar gyur cig /rang bzhin rnam dag ngang du ro gcig kyang*/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i bdud bzhi'i dmag tshogs la/ /mig 'phrul lta bu'i brgya bzhi'i mchod pa 'di/ /brag cha lta bu'i dbyangs kyis mchod par bgyi/ /sprul pa lta bu'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /chos dbyings rnam par dag pa chos kyi sku/ /bcol ldan mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku thob nas/ /'gro kun bdud bzhi'i dgra las rgyal gyur cig /ces brjod/ gnyis pa thun mong du 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ 7 kyai/ 'chi bdag bdud dang phung po'i bdud/ /nyon mongs bdud dang lha bu'i bdud/ /sgrib ba rnam bzhi las byung ba'i/ /bdud bzhi bdud kyi dmag tshogs rnams/ /da lta rgyu sbyor yon bdag gis/ /sgrib pa rnam bzhi bsal ba'i phyir/ /mchod par sbyin pa'i las bgyis nas/ /mchod pa bzhi ni dkon mchog gsum/ /mchod yon mar me zhal zas sogs/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags te/ /nyon mongs pa dang shais bya'i sgrib/ /sgrib pa rnam gnyis sbyangs pa yis/ /lha bdud nyon mongs bdud las thar/

/lan chags srog glud 'di bsngos pas/ /lan chags rnam smin bdud las thar/ /sngon tshe rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang*/ /mchod sbyin gtor tshogs 'di bsngos pas/ /da lta rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /bar chad mi mthun rkyen rnams bzlog /grib dang mi gtsang grib ma'i tshogs/ /tshogs gnyis bsags pas dag par byed/ /bdud kyi gtso bo bdud chen bzhi'i/ /bar chad sel byed brgya bzhi ste/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di byin pas/ /bdud chen bzhi po rab tu sel/ /ngar gyi gtso bo 'du pa bzhi/ /'byung ba rnam bzhi 'khrugs pa yis/ /gzugs dang phung po 'jig par byed/ dang po tshangs pa gnas kyis so/ /bgegs kyi gtso bo bdud chen bzhi/ /bar chad rkyen rnams glo bur byed/ /de dag mchod sbyin brgya bzhi yis/ /cho gas gnod byed sel bar byed/ /'gro ba rab 'bring tha ma'i blos/ /gtor ma'i gzugs can ting 'dzin gyis/ /bsags shing byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /bdud chen bzhi la bsngos nas ni/ /mgu ba'i tshul gyis dgyes mdzod la/ /gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor rgyun bcad nas/ /'dod don lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/ /de nas bdud kyi 'bul gtor sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ na maḥs manta buddha nāṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūṃ/ lan brgya rtsa brgyad dam/ ma tha nyer gcig gis bsngos te/ 7 kyai/ bkod mdzes ri rab lta bu'i gtor ma 'di/ /sha dang khrag gis brgyan cing byin brlabs te/ /bdud bzhi gnod byed 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes la phyi nang 'gal rkyen zhi bar mdzod/ / gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ldan pa'i rdzas/ /dbang po drug la rmad byung bde chen bskyed/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di/ /bdud bzhi bdud kyi dmag tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /lus sems ting 'dzin zas gyis tshim gyur nas/ /zag med ting 'dzin zas la spyod gyur cig /kyai/ bcom ldan shākya thub pa'i byin rlabs dang*/

/rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ /mchod sbyin rnam par dag pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /'gro la bdud bzhi'i bar chad sel gyur cig /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes nas/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /bdud kyi bar chad med pa dang*/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob mdzod/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /lo skag zla skag zhag skag dang*/ /bdud bzhi'i dmag tshogs dgra la bsgyur/ /bzhi pa bstod pa ni/ /kyai/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la gnas shing*/ /'gro ba kun gyi gzugs kyi phung po la/ dbang bsgyur stobs ldan phung po'i bdud tshogs la/ /bdag gis phyag 'tshal mchod cing bstod par bgyi/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la gnas shing*/ /'gro ba kun gyi tshor ba'i phung po la/ /dbang bsgyur stobs ldan nyon mongs bdud tshogs la/ /bdag gis phyag 'tshal mchod cing bstod par bgyi/ /ci yang med pa'i skye mched la gnas shing*/ /'gro ba kun gyi 'du shes phung po la/ /dbang bsgyur stobs ldan lha bu'i bdud tshogs la/ /bdag gis phyag 'tshal mchod cing bstod par bgyi/ /yod min med min skye mched la gnas shing*/ /'gro ba kun gyi 'du byed phung po la/ /dbang bsgyur stobs ldan 'chi bdag bdud tshogs la/ /bdag gis phyag 'tshal mchod cing bstod par bgyi/ /bdud bzhi'i 'khor du gtogs pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya chen 'di 'bul bas/ /gnod cing gdug pa'i 'tshe ba kun zhi nas/ /bdud bzhi'i dgra las rtag tu rgyal gyur cig /bskang gso dang 'brel na ni tshe bstod pa sngar ma song na 'dir btang*/ de min 'dir gzhi bdag gi gtor ma spyi ltar 'bul/ lnga ba glud gtong ba la/ glud rdzong du rin po che dang*/ 'bru sna/ zas sna/ gos sna/ chang phud/

gser skyems sogs sta gon byas la/ glud bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sbyin pa'i bdag po'i glud phung khams skye mched dang yan lag thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta nas sambha ra hūṃ/ lan bdun nam gsum gyis bsngo/ /hūṃ/ nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /nga ni dpal chen he ru ka /nga ni khro bo'i rgyal po ste/ /nga ni log 'dren bgegs tshogs 'dul/ /nga ni gsang chen kun gyi bdag /nga yi bka' la mi nyan med/ /lha klu gzhin rje ma mo dang*/ /gza' dang rgyu skar gnod sbyin dang*/ /srin po sha za la sogs pa/ /gang dag bgegs byed su yang rung*/ khyad par bdud bzhi'i dmag tshogs la/ /rin chen mdzes pa'i ngar glud 'di/ /'bru zan rin chen snying po can/ /skye mched khams dang dbang po lnga/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras pa 'di/ /sngags dang ting 'dzin phyag rgya yis/ /nam mkha'i khams gang byin brlabs nas/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /glud du bdud bzhi'i tshogs la 'bul/ /mi yi dod du glud 'di bzhes/ /mdzes pa'i ngar glud rgyan ldan 'di/ /rnam thos bur 'gran nor mang ldan/ /skabs gsum phun tshogs la 'khu zhing*/ /nag po'i sde las rgyal byed pa/ /rig 'dzin sngags 'chang bdag cag dang*/ /rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag glud du 'bul/ /rin chen mdzes pa'i ngar glud 'di/ /yon tan brgya phrag dang ldan zhing*/ /glud kyi yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /rin chen 'bru sna'i snying po can/ /mgo la zer mo'i 'phen bzang skra/ /mu tig dag las klad pa byas/ /lung thang mig la mar gyi mdangs/ /mgron bu'i so la dar dmar ljags/ /bkrag mdangs dung so ya la la/ /gsung ngag skad snyan tse re re/ /lag pa g.yas pa gser las byas/ /lag pa g.yon pa dngul las byas/ /rkang ba zangs dang lcags las byas/ /gos bzang na bza' lhubs se lhubs/ /rin chen mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /'gro mkhas de ni khyung gi 'gros/

/lus ngag yid gsum yan lag ldan/ /phung po lnga yang 'di la yod/ /tshe srog dbugs gsum 'di la yod/ /dbang po rnam lnga 'di la yod/ /khams chen bco brgyad 'di la yod/ /skye mched bcu gnyis 'di la yod/ /smra ba mkhas dang 'dzum mdangs can/ 'khor g.yog ngar mi brgya phrag rnams/ /bdag cag rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /glud du bdud bzhi'i tshogs la 'bul/ /nor ldan mdzes pa'i ngar glud bzhes/ /mtshar sdug ldan pa'i ngar glud bzhes/ blta na sdug pa'i ngar glud bzhes/ /brgya phrag yon tan dang ldan pa/ /m-i las mchog gyur ngar glung 'di/ /rig sngags 'chang ba bdag cag dang*/ /rgyu sbyor yon bdag glud du 'bul/ /mi las glud dga' glud bzhes la/ /bdud bzhi'i gnod 'tshe zhi bar mdzod/ /bzung ba thong la bcings pa phrol/ khram la btab na khram kha phyes/ /sho la babs ma sho rde bskyungs/ /byad du chud na byad kha chod/ /bdud bzhi'i dmag tshogs dgra la bsgyur/ /bdud kyi khram kha dgra la bsgyur/ /rgyal po'i smyos 'bog dgra la bsgyur/ /the'u rang srid rku dgra la bsgyur/ /glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig bzlog /ye 'braug sum brgya drug cu bzlog /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams bzlog /stong phrag brgyad bcu'i bgegs rnams bzlog /sum brgya drug cu'i gdon rnams bzlog /yas bdud g.yos dang mas sre las/ /ya tshan rgya 'dre thams cad bzlog /ma bsru'i byur 'dre thams cad bzlog /lo zla'i skag rnams dgra la bsgyur/ /zhag dang za skag dgra la bsgyur/ /rmi lam mtshan ma ngan pa dang*/ /'byung po'i dal yams dgra la bsgyur/ /bskang gso dang 'brel na bskul bzhag pa rnams 'dir gtong ste/ de yang*/ khyod la zhu zhing sogs dang 'chi bdag ma dang ri rab lhun po ma lta bu'o/ /de nas/ 7 kyai/ sngon tshe rgyal ba shāka thub kyi/ /mchod sbyin phyag rgya g.yas pa ru/ /mchod sbyin brgya bzhi'i rdzas bsags te/ /phyag sor rtse mor mgron bkug nas/

/bdud bzhi mchod de mdangs dang ldan/ /sngon tshe rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang*/ /da lta bdag dang yon bdag gi /mchod sbyin glud gtor 'di 'khyer la/ /rang rang 'dug pa'i gnas su dengs/ /lha bdud dkar po bya ba khyod/ /ci yang med pa'i gnas su dengs/ /'chi bdag bdud ni nag po khyod/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas gnas su dengs/ nyon mongs bdud ni dmar po khyod/ /rnam shes mtha' yas gnas su dengs/ /phung po'i bdud ni ser po khyod/ /yod min med min gnas su dengs/ /nyon mongs sgrib dang bag chags sgrib/ /las kyi sgrib dang shes bya'i sgrib/ /sgrib pa bzhi las byung ba yi/ /lha bu'i bdud dang nyon mongs bdud/ /'chi bdag bdud dang phung po'i bdud/ /bdud bzhi bdud kyi rgyal po bzhi/ /skye mched mu bzhi'i gnas su dengs/ /ces brjod cing*/ gzugs brnyan mchod rdzas bcas gshegs pa ni/ sā tstsha rnams khang steng lta bur 'jog cing*/ mar me'i gong bu zan yin na ni de dag lha bdud dkar po ngar glud nyi shu lha bshos nyi shu bcas shar du gtong*/ phung bdud ser po ngar glud nyi shu lha bshos nyi shu bcas lhor gtong*/ 'chi bdud nag po ngar glud nyi shu lha bshos nyi shu bcas nub tu gtong*/ nyon mongs bdud dmar ngar glud nyi shu lha bshos nyi shu bcas byang du gtong*/ yon bdag gi glud dang ngar glud nyi shu lha bshos nyi shu bcas gnod byed yod pa'i phyogs sam/ yod par the tshom za ba'i phyogs su btang nas/ kyai/ srid gsum 'di na ci yang rung*/ /'di na gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /tshur shog rgyal ba'i bka' la nyon/ /byang chub sems dang ldan par mdzod/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i lha 'dre la/ /sa gzhi gang ba'i glud 'bul lo/ /nged kyis 'bul ba mi nor ro/ khyed kyis bzhes pa ma nor cig /bdud bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ /gnod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs rnams/ /rang rang so so'i gnas song ste/ /byams pa'i sems dang ldan par mdzod/

/de nas bskang gso dang 'brel na bzlog pa gzhung bzhin byas nas/ mthun pa'i dngos grub mas dngos grub blang*/ min na/ bla ma mchog gsum bden byin dang*/ /mchod sbyin 'di ltar bgyis pa'i mthus/ /rnal 'byor sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba thams cad zlog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu bzlog /gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu zlog /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga zlog /steng gdon gza' yi gnod pa zlog /'og gdon klu yi gnod pa zlog /bar gdon rgyal po'i gnod pa zlog /mi nad phyugs nad thams cad zlog /rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa zlog /lo skag zla skag zhag skag zlog /mdor na mi dang mi min gyis/ /gnod pa ji snyed mchis pa zlog /rnal 'byor sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la/ /tshe ring nad med longs spyod sogs/ /'dod rgu ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /'bad med lhun gyis 'grub gyur cig /ces bya'o/ /de nas btang rag gi mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra tī tstsha hūṃ swāhā/ zhes sogs gyis mchod/ gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo zhes sogs sam/ thabs mkhas thugs rje ma sogs bstod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs dang*/ yig brgya brjod cing*/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*/ zhes sogs kyis bzod gsol byas te/ rten yod na/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu/ /zhes sogs kyis brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na/ badzra muḥ ye shes pa'i mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces dang*/ bkra shis rgyas bsdus ci rigs byas nas las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// // zhor la sā tstsha rab gnas mdor bsdus zhig brjod par bya ste/ rgyas pa ni gzhan du shes par bya la/ bsdus pa ni/ rang ny-id lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ hrīḥṣtīḥ'am/ a mṛ ta sogs dang*/ sumbha ni brjod cing*/ yungs kar sogs kyis rten gyi bgegs bskrad nas/ sā tstsha bsangs sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las sā tstsha rnams rnam snang dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgyas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ dar gyi bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras shing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin pa āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi ye shes pa dang*/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ ye shes pa dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ dam tshig ba so so dang gnyis su med bar gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ bai ro tsa na arghaṃ nas shapta pra tī tstsha hūṃ swāhā'i bar gyis mchod de/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag/rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /ting nge 'dzin ldan phyag rgya can/ /rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /ces bstod/ oṃ budhā bai ro tsa na oṃ swāhā/ zhes 'grub bzla/ oṃ badzra sa twa hūṃ/ lan gsum/ oṃ tsakṣu sa manta tsakṣu bi sho dha ni swāhā/ zhes spyan dbye/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rnam snang 'od du zhu ba las sā tstsha'i rnam pa can du gyur/ de nas/ ye dharmā/ lan bdun brjod de/ su pra tiṣṭhas brtan bzhugs dang*/ ji srid me dang chu dang ni/ /rlung gis bskal ba 'jig par du/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bcom ldan khyod ni bzhugs par mdzod/ /lan gsum dang*/ shis brjod ci rigs bya'o/ 7 /tshul 'dir 'bang las byung ba'i dges/ /bdag sogs 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam rgyal te/ /'chi med chos sku myur thob shog /ces bdud bzhi'i dpung las rgyal bar byed pa'i brgya bzhi'i cho ga 'chi bdag bzlog ces bya ba 'di ni/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis re gnyis la phan 'dogs kyi bsam pas dam pa snga ma'i phyag srol la cung zad re kha bskang nas 'jug pa bde khul du co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba ste/
par gyi yi ge pa ni tā yil lung gi blo bzang don grub bo/ /maṅga laṃ// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/brgya bzhi'i cho ga 'chi bdag kun bzlog ces bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 156--PAGE 137--PAGE 136-
